## B-02 / B-03 / B-04  Staged expiry reminders

Replaces the one-a-day blob from `email_digest.py`.

Scans **every register in the portal that carries an expiry field** (23 of them, generated from your own `forms_data.py`) and chases the *named owner* of each document at 90 / 60 / 30 / 14 / 7 / 3 / 1 days, then daily once overdue.

At 90 and 30 days it also opens a renewal to-do on the portal's own To-Do board, assigned to that owner.

Inside 7 days it escalates from email to email + WhatsApp + Slack.

**Turn off `send_digest.bat` in Task Scheduler once this runs.**

WITH tracked AS (
  SELECT 'COR-001' AS form_code, 'Corporate Document Register' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("document_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("responsible_person", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("expiry_date", '')::date AS due_date, COALESCE(status,'') AS status

)
SELECT form_code, form_title, id, doc_no, item, owner_name, status,
       to_char(due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date,
       (due_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_left
FROM tracked
WHERE due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 95
ORDER BY due_date ASC;

INSERT INTO todos (user_id, text, color, done, created_at, status)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT id FROM users
      WHERE lower(COALESCE(full_name,'')) = lower($1)
         OR lower(COALESCE(username,''))  = lower($1)
      LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role ILIKE 'Director%' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)),
  $2, '#f59e0b', 0,
  to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'To Do'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todos WHERE text = $2 AND COALESCE(status,'') <> 'Done')
RETURNING id, text;
